meta.description: Coarse historical civilization extents for overlay on aphorism-author maps (c. 1000 BCE to present). Rough estimates only.
meta.rendering: Core polygon drawn at full opacity; opacity falls linearly to 0 from the core edge to the halo edge (properties.halo), so overlapping halos show boundaries and intermingling. Halo fully contains core, typically 100-500 km beyond it.
meta.coords: GeoJSON [lon, lat], WGS84; outer rings counter-clockwise.
meta.dates: EDTF; BCE astronomical (400 BCE = -0399). 'when' is the snapshot, 'valid' the interval it represents.
